name: Lavender
source:
Main character suddenly acquires an unstable "predictive ability" that he can not control. He has to see near future against his will. So started the days full of bliss where the the scent of lavender drifts everywhere on a soft wind. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公突然获得了一种无法控制、并不稳定的“预知能力”。他不得不违背自己的意愿看见不久后的未来。于是，处处有柔风送来薰衣草香气的幸福时光就此开始。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
